kids.text:
E-commerce Management & Creator Collaboration Platform

Sellflo is a digital commerce management platform designed to connect merchants with creators, simplify product promotion, and provide actionable insights into business performance.

The platform enables merchants to manage products, monitor orders, track revenue, and create marketing campaigns, while creators can discover products, participate in affiliate campaigns, monitor clicks and conversions, and track their earnings.
The goal was to design an intuitive, data-driven dashboard that helps both user groups make informed decisions and manage their activities from a centralized workspace.

kids.name: Merchants and creators often need to manage multiple activities across separate tools. Merchants may struggle to monitor sales performance, manage products, and evaluate campaign effectiveness. Creators may find it difficult to identify suitable products, track affiliate links, and understand which promotional activities generate revenue.

kids.name: The sidebar groups major features into clearly recognizable sections. Design rationale: Persistent navigation helps users move between tasks without losing context. Grouping related items also reduces the effort required to locate key features. B. Performance Summary Cards The dashboard presents high-level metrics such as: Total orders Total earnings Total clicks Total conversions Each card combines a prominent metric, an icon, and a contextual performance indicator. Design rationale: Users should be able to understand their current performance quickly before exploring detailed analytics. For merchants, these cards can emphasize orders, sales, and conversions. For creators, the same component can display earnings, clicks, commissions, and conversions.

kids.name: The analytics section uses line and bar charts to communicate changes in performance over time. Line charts help users compare clicks, orders, or revenue trends. Bar charts help users compare daily earnings, payouts, or campaign activity. Tooltips can reveal precise values when users interact with individual data points. Design rationale: Clear data visualization helps users identify trends and investigate performance changes without navigating through lengthy reports. D. Product and Activity Table The table displays operational information in a structured format, including product names, locations, dates, quantities, amounts, and statuses. Design rationale: Tables make detailed records easy to scan, compare, and review. Status indicators help users distinguish completed, pending, and rejected transactions. For Sellflo, this component can be adapted to show orders for merchants and commission or payout records for creators.

sections.body:
